tool.description: Prepare a source-bound component value change for human review in Hazlo Mexa. Use an inspected reference and a user-confirmed value. For a follow-up, read_verified_result returns the actual edited components: pass its job_id as base_job_id and its sha256 as result_sha256 together, retaining the original selection capability for project context. Hazlo revalidates and captures the verified edited sheet and dependencies, preserving the original selection. Does not approve, execute or live-edit an open user document.
tool.name: propose_schematic_value
